tokens.creator: 0x86268c712d63aa2115f763d487af8567087d38c3
tokens.name: Goose
tokens.descr: There’s a new tool called Goose, created by Jack Dorsey, the founder of Twitter, and it’s completely free. When you tell it something simple like “I want a site like YouTube,” Goose takes over the entire process on its own. It starts the project from scratch, writes all the necessary code, loads every dependency required, and even corrects any mistakes it encounters along the way. What sets Goose apart is its emphasis on privacy and independence. You never pay a cent for using it, and everything runs locally on your own device so no one else can see your code. Being fully open-source means you’re not tied to any company or platform, giving you complete control without lock-in concerns. The real game-changer is how it lowers barriers to creation. Previously, turning an idea into a working application required hiring a developer, but now all you need is a clear concept. Goose handles the heavy lifting, making it accessible for anyone with an idea to build something real.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
